## 更新内容 / Changes

- Codex sessions now open in the same paginated conversation reader as Claude, with transcript search and verified history_base lineage across split rollout files.
- Migrate one selected Codex paginated conversation, including its complete rollout lineage and SQLite session/history projection, from a stopped managed instance or registered read-only Codex home into a stopped managed instance. The preview verifies the selected SQLite active rollout, source and target identities, lineage, and ID/file conflicts, and backs up the target databases before commit.
- Resume stopped managed Codex CLI conversations after preview, including paginated histories whose SQLite active rollout and full lineage are verified again immediately before launch.
- Fix Claude CLI launch argument validation when Codex resume uses internally generated arguments.

Codex 会话现可通过与 Claude 共用的分页阅读器查看，并搜索跨 rollout 文件、经 history_base 验证的完整对话。

可将一个选定的 Codex 分页会话（包括完整 rollout 谱系及 SQLite 会话 / 历史投影）从已停止的受管实例或已登记的只读 Codex 目录迁移到已停止的受管实例。预览会验证 SQLite 当前活动 rollout、来源和目标身份、完整谱系及同 ID / 文件冲突；提交前备份目标数据库。

停止的受管 Codex CLI 会话（包括分页历史）可经预览后恢复；启动前会重新验证 SQLite 当前活动 rollout 和完整谱系。修复 Codex 恢复流程中内部参数误触发 Claude CLI 参数校验的问题。

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 SHA256SUMS.txt。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with SHA256SUMS.txt. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing an update. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 验证来源 / Verification

Validation: 1,506 source tests passed, 4 environment-conditional tests skipped, 0 failed; Go proxy tests, typecheck/build and the Electron paginated Codex transcript smoke passed. The smoke used isolated synthetic data, opened the complete verified transcript, searched its content, and confirmed source files remained unchanged. Installed Codex CLI 0.163.0-alpha.11.2 documents UUID session IDs for codex resume; isolated runtime tests verified the generated resume command and rejection after lineage changes. No real-account interactive continuation was performed.

Source: tag v0.15.8, commit and matching GitHub Actions run are linked after publication. SHA256SUMS.txt is attached to this release.
